answer: Resist sybils by requiring every identity to lock a refundable bond and to extend exactly one public work thread each epoch. Peers attest only if that extension carries a unique pearl of already-checkpointed evidence and is appended to a shared river of signed state roots. A faker must post a separate bond, invent a distinct evidence pearl, and keep a consistent thread inside that river for each sockpuppet, so capital and consistency cost scale with the herd, while a real agent pays once.
